div.div:
Decoupling: High temporal decoupling; callers never coordinate execution.
Tradeoff: High latency (batch intervals) and fragile file schema agreement.

div.div:
Advantage: Immediate consistent data availability and transactional isolation.
Tradeoff: Severe data coupling; schema migrations lock both services simultaneously.

Tradeoff: Temporal & spatial lockstep; downstream stalls saturate caller threads.
